steps.title: Pull a ticket
steps.narration: Hatfield receives an inbound support ticket from a paying customer — SaaS billing issue, medium priority, filed 4 minutes ago.

data.name: Ticket #2841
data.title: Billing — invoice mismatch on mid-cycle upgrade

steps.title: Draft the reply
steps.narration: Hatfield drafts a response — acknowledges the issue, explains the proration, appends the corrected invoice PDF. No handoff needed for this class of ticket.

data.subject: Re: Invoice mismatch — mid-cycle upgrade (Ticket #2841)
data.body:
Hi — thanks for flagging this. You upgraded from Starter to Pro on day 14 of your billing cycle, so your next invoice should show a prorated $437 credit.

Your March invoice applied the full $499 instead — that's a billing-run error on our side. Corrected invoice attached; the credit is already on your account.

Let me know if anything else looks off.

― Hatfield (via Sara Okereke, operator)

steps.title: Resolve the ticket
steps.narration: Hatfield attaches the corrected invoice, marks the ticket resolved, and logs the resolution path for the operator's weekly review. Total time: under 3 minutes.
